query: WITH games AS (SELECT m.match_id,m.start_time,m.leagueid,l.name,l.tier,m.duration,m.radiant_team_id,m.dire_team_id,m.radiant_win FROM matches m JOIN match_patch a USING(match_id) JOIN leagues l USING(leagueid) WHERE m.start_time >= 1795037287 AND m.start_time < 1795784400 AND m.version IS NOT NULL AND a.patch='7.42' AND l.tier IN ('premium','professional') ORDER BY m.start_time,m.match_id LIMIT 500) SELECT g.match_id,g.start_time,g.leagueid,g.name,g.tier,g.duration,g.radiant_team_id,g.dire_team_id,g.radiant_win,json_agg(json_build_object('slot',p.player_slot,'hero',p.hero_id,'lane',p.lane_role,'roaming',p.is_roaming,'lastHits10',p.lh_t[11],'purchaseLog',CASE WHEN p.hero_id IN (2,5,6,8,21,23,63,66,81,84) THEN p.purchase_log ELSE NULL END) ORDER BY p.player_slot) AS players FROM games g JOIN player_matches p USING(match_id) GROUP BY g.match_id,g.start_time,g.leagueid,g.name,g.tier,g.duration,g.radiant_team_id,g.dire_team_id,g.radiant_win HAVING count(*)=10 ORDER BY g.start_time,g.match_id
